reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reads Paul's anathema in 1 Corinthians 16:22 as a prophetic verdict, not a personal curse, distinguishing it from the cursing Romans 12:14 forbids.

sides.snippet: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don't curse.
sides.verseText: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don't curse.

sides.snippet: If any man doesn't love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed.
sides.verseText: If any man doesn't love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Come, Lord!
